isolation_boundary_rule: MUST_NEVER_AFFECT: V_nat, V_built, GVI_eye, GMI, V_sign, SVF, GFAPI, V_pave, IAS, I, Y, D, a, b, c, M
source_commit_message: Ignore .env explicitly (safety net for the API key file)
repository_role: Upstream OSM street-network → evenly spaced street-view camera-node geometry and QA. It is not the VLM, segmentation, Space Syntax, GWR or behavior model.

sampling_defaults.streetview_max_snap_rule: None -> spacing_m when validation is enabled

heading_semantics.heading_fwd_deg: bearing from current node toward the next node along the ordered street path; last node reuses previous segment bearing

streetview_metadata_validation.upstream_behavior: When enabled, nodes without nearby panorama metadata are dropped and covered nodes are snapped to returned panorama coordinates before output.

app_relevance.role: lat/lng + node_id + street name can be imported as acquisition geometry provenance.
heading_fwd/rev provides a path-derived local street axis, useful for camera/orientation provenance.
APP may derive 0/90/180/270 candidate centers from heading_fwd; the repo itself does not output four teacher views.
QA table can support sampling integrity review but does not validate VLM scores.
Coverage checking exists, but output CSV does not retain pano_id/date, so APP cannot prove coverage from node CSV alone.
A street tangent does not make existing team walk-relative L/R images equivalent to teacher orthogonal views.
Repo node IDs use street_slug_sequence and do not provide a committed crosswalk to n##### Murray Hill IDs.

current_main_consistency_audit.finding: Current root README and committed area examples describe polygon-only selection, but current pipeline.py still declares REQUIRED_KEYS=(area_name,bbox), builds a box, clips corridors to the box, then applies polygon as a post-resample point filter. The latest main therefore contains selection-contract drift.
current_main_consistency_audit.app_policy: Do not import polygon-only claims as authoritative research provenance until the upstream repo reconciles README/config/pipeline.

boundaries: No generated <area>_nodes.csv is committed in the inspected repository tree; the APP cannot auto-populate real node rows from GitHub alone.
Street-view metadata coverage is an optional upstream operation; because pano_id/date are discarded before io_writers output, a node CSV alone cannot demonstrate panorama identity/date.
APP-derived orthogonal headings are geometry candidates only and do not auto-approve existing Qwen orientation protocol.
This repository does not supply segmentation masks, Qwen scores, H/W, true hemispherical SVF, Space Syntax Choice/Integration, local GWR betas, observed t_base, or validated lambda.
